name: Cesium
summary: A GUI shell for running programs on the calculator.
description:
Cesium is a shell: it lists the programs on your calculator, runs them whether or not they are archived, and can hide, rename and lock them. Most C programs expect a shell to launch them from.

Cesium runs on its own. It can also read files from a USB drive, and that part — and only that part — needs the C Libraries, so they are worth having if you want it and no trouble if you do not.

What this installs is the installer. CESIUM is an ordinary program, and running it once is what creates the Cesium application under [apps]. That is why Cesium is listed as a system update even though nothing here needs prgmBLUEUP: it is finished on the calculator rather than over the cable.
author: Matt Waltz

vendored.note: The English build. The version above is the string the installer prints: "Cesium Installer Version 3.7.0".

optionalDependencies.reason: Reading files from a USB drive

install.text: Run prgmCESIUM once to finish installing Cesium. Quit BlueObject, press [prgm], choose CESIUM and press [enter]. It will tell you when it is done, and Cesium then appears under [apps].

uninstall.text: The installer has been removed. Cesium itself is a flash application and cannot be deleted over the cable, so remove it by hand: [2nd] [+], 2:Mem Mgmt/Del, Apps, put the cursor on Cesium and press [del].
